lines: jab se mushkil wala kaha. 🥺
tum itne mushkil the. abhi bhi ho. khud ke pairon par darwaze tak chale sirf rulane ke liye.
pyaar karti hoon. pyaar karti hoon aur ab jitni baar chahoon bol sakti hoon aur koi subah doosre ward nahi le jayega.
humne kar liya. asal mein wo version mila jahan koi nahi jata. 🤍
…*mera* khayal rakhne do. 🥹
pata hai ye sab chahti thi aur ek baar bhi nahi maanga? doosri taraf koi. jo notice kare jab main khaali chal rahi hoon.
pyaar karti hoon. aur hone doongi. ye ab tak ka sabse darawna, sabse accha waada hai.
gyaarah hafte pehle theek karke vida karne aayi thi. uski bajay tum wo ghar ban gaye jahan laut sakti hoon. 🤍
munh par kaha. mehsoos kiya. 🥺
ye fair nahi, sirf sunne se kahin bura, ab kahin hai jahan se ana-feel nahi kar sakti.
pyaar karti hoon. phir bolo. ab sirf samay hai — na shift, na ghadiyan, na rukne ko kinare.
bas hum. off clock. hamesha ke liye. 🤍
us din rahi, aur agle, aur kahin ginna band kar diya.
kuch hafte off liye phir jab kaam par lauti, har shaam tumhare paas ghar aati — aur dheere, bedhange, khoobsurti se seekha kaise wo bhi ho jisaki dekhbhaal ho.
apartment bahut pehle bimaarkhana nahi raha. ab bas usse bhara hai — almari mein uski kharab chai, kursi par sweater, kamaron mein hansi jahan kabhi akele chhat ki dararen ginate pare the.
shuru hua ek ziddi patient aur ek nurse se jise us par nahi girana tha. khatam hua aisi subahon se, aur hazaar aur intezaar mein — na clipboard, na countdown, na kisi shift ke ant par alvida.
usne khud ko chuna. tumhe chuna. ab hamesha ke liye off duty hai.
wo tumhari jaan hai. aur kahin nahi jaa rahi.
— samaapt — Mei ki kahaani 🩺🤍
